# telnyx_ai_avatars (Data Source)

Lists ai avatars, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_ai_avatar`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stock avatars Telnyx provides.
data "telnyx_ai_avatars" "stock" {
  filter_avatar_type = "stock"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_avatar_type` (String) Whether the avatar is provided by Telnyx or was uploaded by the authenticated organization. One of `custom`, `stock`.
- `filter_id` (String) Stable identifier returned by the Avatars API. Discover available stock IDs with GET /v2/ai/avatars and filter[avatar_type]=stock rather than maintaining a fixed list. Custom avatar IDs use the `avatar_` prefix and must belong to the authenticated organization. The service validates that the selected avatar is available.
- `filter_name` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `ai_avatars` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_avatars))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_avatars"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_avatars`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_type` (String) Whether the avatar is provided by Telnyx or was uploaded by the authenticated organization.
- `content_type` (String) MIME type of a custom avatar image.
- `created_at` (String) Time when the custom avatar was created.
- `height_px` (Number) Decoded height of a custom avatar image.
- `hosted` (Boolean) Indicates that avatar rendering runs on Telnyx-operated infrastructure.
- `id` (String) Stable identifier returned by the Avatars API. Discover available stock IDs with GET /v2/ai/avatars and filter[avatar_type]=stock rather than maintaining a fixed list. Custom avatar IDs use the `avatar_` prefix and must belong to the authenticated organization. The service validates that the selected avatar is available.
- `image_url` (String) HTTPS image URL suitable for an avatar selection thumbnail. If the URL expires, list or retrieve the avatar again to refresh it.
- `image_url_expires_at` (String) Expiration time of `image_url`. Omitted when the URL does not expire.
- `name` (String) Customer-facing avatar name.
- `provider` (String) Avatar provider. The first release supports Telnyx avatars.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of a custom avatar image in bytes.
- `suggested_voice_id` (String) Optional recommended Telnyx text-to-speech voice for this avatar. An omitted field or empty string means no recommendation is available. Custom avatars have no suggested voice. It is informational and selecting the avatar does not automatically change the AI Assistant's configured voice.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the custom avatar was last updated.
- `width_px` (Number) Decoded width of a custom avatar image.
